scope: physical planar wheel-odometry evaluation; z, roll and pitch not calibrated

physical_direction_anchor.note: Preserves the prior physical evaluation axes, not the opposite CAD DriveBase visualization axes.

measurement.ambiguity_resolution: Closest fitted LiDAR origin to the current CAD front-mounted origin, without wheel-odometry fitting.
measurement.note: Residuals and temporal repeatability are not absolute accuracy. Recalibrate after remounting.
